On dual-PWM boards both PWM control inputs are high. On V4 enable/direction boards DISABLE is low and EN duty is zero; direction does not affect braking. The command ID and payload are the same for all boards; firmware selects the hardware behavior from the board configuration. Short braking does not regulate or hold a specific position. A motor owned by an active platform is rejected with MOTOR_OWNED; use BRAKE_PLATFORM for platform wheels. Re-initialize the motor controller before using target-speed control again. commands.description: This command sets the global update frequency (in Hz) of the closed-loop motor controller task. All motor controllers share a single control loop, so this frequency is global and affects every currently running controller as well as any created afterwards; the PID sampling time is updated to match. The requested value is clamped to the supported range of 1 to 1000 Hz (the 1000 Hz maximum is bounded by the 1 ms RTOS tick). The value is then quantized to the 1 ms RTOS tick (period_ms = 1000 / frequency), so effective frequencies are 1000/N Hz. A value of 0 is invalid and ignored. Defaults to 10 Hz (100 ms) at start-up.

properties.description: The controller update frequency in Hz. Valid range 1 to 1000 Hz; values outside are clamped, and 0 is ignored.

header.description: Shared header. Length counts subsequent bytes. Message IDs increment from 1 through 65535 then wrap to 1; 0 is reserved for unsolicited messages or errors lacking an ID. Replies and errors echo the initiating request ID. Senders must skip outstanding IDs.

error_codes.name: INCOMPATIBLE_PROTOCOL
error_codes.description: The requested protocol version is incompatible with this firmware.

error_codes.name: INVALID_ARGUMENT
error_codes.description: A field is invalid, out of range, or inconsistent with the pending request.

error_codes.name: UNKNOWN_COMMAND
error_codes.description: The received command ID is not accepted by the controller.

error_codes.name: INVALID_LENGTH
error_codes.description: The complete message has an invalid header or payload length.

error_codes.name: MOTOR_OWNED
error_codes.description: The motor belongs to a platform; use the corresponding platform command.

error_codes.name: INTERNAL_ERROR
error_codes.description: The controller could not execute or encode the operation.

error_codes.name: CLOCK_NOT_READY
error_codes.description: Initial clock setup is incomplete; wait for READY. Uptime mode also supports READY.

error_codes.name: TIME_SYNC_FAILED
error_codes.description: Initial time sync exhausted its attempts without a valid sample.

error_codes.name: ODOMETRY_NOT_INITIALIZED
error_codes.description: Odometry is not running; start odometry before requesting a measurement.

error_codes.name: SAMPLE_NOT_AVAILABLE
error_codes.description: The requested measurement is not ready yet, including after initialization or reset; retry after an update.

error_codes.name: ENCODER_NOT_INITIALIZED
error_codes.description: Initialize the encoder before reading it or starting encoder odometry.

error_codes.name: PLATFORM_NOT_INITIALIZED
error_codes.description: Initialize a platform before performing this operation.

error_codes.name: MOTOR_NOT_INITIALIZED
error_codes.description: Initialize the motor before setting its speed.

error_codes.name: CONTROLLER_NOT_INITIALIZED
error_codes.description: Start or initialize the closed-loop controller before setting its target.

error_codes.name: INIT_REQUIRED
error_codes.description: Send a valid INIT request before performing this connection-dependent operation.

error_codes.name: SENSOR_NOT_AVAILABLE
error_codes.description: The selected sensor is not defined on this board.

error_codes.name: SUBSCRIPTION_LIMIT
error_codes.description: This connection has no free subscription slots; unsubscribe an existing source first.
